nodes.description: Mapping address=>uint256 holding token balances, mutated by transfer, transferFrom, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>uint256 allowance, mutated by approve, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance, transferFrom and burnFrom.
Total supply counter, decremented on every burn performed inside transfer and transferFrom.
Public constant-like percent value (100) used by the burn-fee rounding logic.
Payable constructor that mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
View getter returning _totalSupply.
View getter returning _balances[owner].
View getter returning _allowed[owner][spender].
Computes the burn amount for a value using ceil rounding plus mul/div on basePercent.
External transfer that burns a rounded percentage of the value and updates balances and totalSupply before emitting events.
Public loop that calls transfer for each receiver/amount pair in a caller supplied array.
Sets _allowed[msg.sender][spender] to the supplied value.
Allowance based transfer that burns a rounded percentage, updates balances, totalSupply and the allowance.
Adds addedValue to the caller allowance for spender.
Subtracts subtractedValue from the caller allowance for spender.
Internal mint that credits balances and emits Transfer from address(0).
External burn entry point that delegates to _burn for msg.sender.
Internal burn that checks amount, decrements totalSupply and balances and emits Transfer to address(0).
External burn on behalf of account using the caller allowance, then calls _burn.
Caller controlled address used for balance, allowance and authorization checks.
Unbounded loop invoking transfer per entry, enabling repeated state transitions and gas griefing in a single transaction.
Rounding arithmetic (ceil + mul + div by 10000) that can inflate the computed burn amount relative to the transferred value.
Burn is simulated by decrementing _totalSupply and emitting Transfer to address(0) instead of routing through _burn, bypassing its checks.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Burn amount returned by findOnePercent inside transfer.
value minus tokensToBurn in transfer.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.

Burn amount returned by findOnePercent inside transferFrom.
value minus tokensToBurn in transferFrom.
Array of receiver addresses passed to multiTransfer.
Array of amounts passed to multiTransfer.
Loop index iterating over the receiver array in multiTransfer.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance value parameter of approve.
Value parameter of findOnePercent.
Ceil-rounded value inside findOnePercent.
Final computed burn percentage inside findOnePercent.
Spender address parameter of increaseAllowance.
Value added to the allowance in increaseAllowance.
Spender address parameter of decreaseAllowance.
Value subtracted from the allowance in decreaseAllowance.

Mint amount parameter of _mint.
Account parameter of _burn.
Burn amount parameter of _burn.
Amount parameter of the external burn function.

edges.reason: transfer authorizes the transfer using the caller controlled msg.sender balance.
transferFrom reads _allowed[from][msg.sender] so the caller input controls the spend authorization.
approve writes _allowed[msg.sender][spender] based on the untrusted caller address.
increaseAllowance modifies the allowance entry keyed by msg.sender.
decreaseAllowance modifies the allowance entry keyed by msg.sender.
burn burns the balance of whichever address calls the function (msg.sender).
burnFrom checks _allowed[account][msg.sender] before burning another account's tokens.
constructor mints the entire supply to the deployer msg.sender.
findOnePercent output determines the burn amount deducted inside transfer.
findOnePercent output determines the burn amount deducted inside transferFrom.
transfer debits _balances[msg.sender] and credits _balances[to].
transfer reduces _totalSupply by the burned amount.
transferFrom debits _balances[from] and credits _balances[to].
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in _allowed.
transferFrom reduces _totalSupply by the burned amount.
approve stores the allowance in _allowed.
increaseAllowance adds to the stored allowance in _allowed.
decreaseAllowance subtracts from the stored allowance in _allowed.
_mint credits _balances[account].
_burn debits _balances[account].
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
burn delegates execution to the internal _burn routine.
burnFrom delegates the actual burn to _burn after the allowance check.
burnFrom decrements _allowed[account][msg.sender] before burning.
multiTransfer loops and re-enters transfer for each receiver, repeating the full state transition sequence.
multiTransfer drives the unbounded loop that repeatedly invokes transfer.
findOnePercent performs the ceil and mul/div rounding that forms the burn calculation.
The rounding result is consumed by transfer to compute tokensToBurn.
The rounding result is consumed by transferFrom to compute tokensToBurn.
transfer burns by reducing _totalSupply and emitting Transfer to address(0) rather than calling _burn.
transferFrom burns by reducing _totalSupply and emitting Transfer to address(0) rather than calling _burn.
totalSupply returns the value stored in _totalSupply.
balanceOf returns the value stored in _balances.
allowance returns the nested value stored in _allowed.
basePercent is used inside findOnePercent for the ceil and mul operations.
basePercent feeds the rounding computation classified as the unsafe arithmetic operation.
transfer recipient parameter flows into the balance credit and the Transfer event.
transfer value parameter bounds the balance debit and the burn computation.
value is passed to findOnePercent whose result becomes tokensToBurn.
tokensToTransfer is derived as value minus tokensToBurn.
findOnePercent return value is assigned to tokensToBurn in transfer.
tokensToTransfer is credited to the recipient and emitted in the Transfer event.
transferFrom source address is debited and checked against _balances.
transferFrom destination address is credited with tokensToTransfer.
transferFrom value parameter drives the debit, burn and allowance decrement.
value is passed to findOnePercent to compute the burn portion.
findOnePercent return value is assigned to tokensToBurn in transferFrom.
value is transformed into tokensToBurn inside transferFrom.
tokensToTransfer is derived as value minus tokensToBurn in transferFrom.
tokensToTransfer is credited and emitted in transferFrom.
receivers array determines which addresses transfer is invoked for.
amounts array supplies the value argument for each transfer call.
loop index controls iteration count of the repeated transfer invocations.
loop index selects each repeated entry into transfer before its state updates settle.
value parameter is the input consumed by the rounding computation.
value is passed to the ceil helper to produce roundValue.
roundValue is multiplied by basePercent and divided by 10000 to produce onePercent.
onePercent is returned to the caller as the burn amount.
spender parameter keys the allowance mapping in approve.
value parameter is written as the allowance in approve.
spender parameter keys the allowance mapping in increaseAllowance.
addedValue parameter is added to the existing allowance.
spender parameter keys the allowance mapping in decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameter is removed from the existing allowance.
account parameter is credited with the minted amount.
amount parameter is added to the beneficiary balance in _mint.
account parameter selects the balance debited by _burn.
amount parameter is validated and deducted by _burn.
amount parameter is forwarded to _burn by the external burn function.
account parameter selects the allowance entry checked in burnFrom.
amount parameter is checked against the allowance and burned by burnFrom.
owner parameter selects the balance entry returned by balanceOf.
owner parameter selects the outer key of the allowance mapping.
spender parameter selects the inner key of the allowance mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only exists to feed the transfer function's balance credit and event.
Amount parameter only carries the value consumed by transfer's burn and debit logic.
Intermediate burn amount is local to transfer and has no independent semantics.
Intermediate net transfer amount is local to transfer.
Source address parameter only affects transferFrom's debit and allowance checks.
Destination address parameter only affects transferFrom's credit.
Amount parameter only drives transferFrom's debit, burn and allowance decrement.
Intermediate burn amount is local to transferFrom.
Intermediate net transfer amount is local to transferFrom.
Receiver array parameter only supplies arguments to the looped transfer calls.
Amount array parameter only supplies arguments to the looped transfer calls.
Loop counter is an implementation detail of multiTransfer's iteration.
Spender parameter only keys the allowance mapping written by approve.
Value parameter is the allowance written by approve.
Input parameter only feeds the rounding computation of findOnePercent.
Ceil-rounded intermediate is local to the rounding computation.
Final rounding result is local to findOnePercent.
Spender parameter only keys the allowance entry updated by increaseAllowance.
Delta parameter is only meaningful inside increaseAllowance.
Spender parameter only keys the allowance entry updated by decreaseAllowance.
Delta parameter is only meaningful inside decreaseAllowance.
Beneficiary parameter is only used to credit the balance in _mint.
Amount parameter is only used to credit the balance in _mint.
Account parameter is only used to debit the balance in _burn.
Amount parameter is only used to decrement balances and supply in _burn.
Amount parameter is forwarded directly to _burn by the external burn wrapper.
Account parameter only selects the allowance and balance handled by burnFrom.
Amount parameter is validated against the allowance before burning in burnFrom.
Owner parameter only selects the balance entry returned by balanceOf.
Owner parameter only selects the outer key read by allowance.
Spender parameter only selects the inner key read by allowance.
